Rule 3 requires that a bank-detail change needs both the principal's approval reference and a completed call-back, and that the handover states both.
The handover from desk names approval reference FD-0926 but does not explicitly state that a call-back to Evergreen Office Supplies has been completed for the new sort code 60-83-71 and account 44019482.
